sonnet.problem: The joke says the 'exact noise' Papa Dorin made in the junk drawer was growling and moaning. His backstory says he went quiet there and held his breath whenever the drawer opened, so this contradicts it. It also jokes about a confession of sin and a lament that salvation is far off.
sonnet.rule: They fit the backstory, never change it, and don't contradict each other in one lesson.
